SELECT c.Segment, MIN(y.Date) AS first_month, MAX(y.Date) AS last_month,
       COUNT(*) AS records, COUNT(y.Consumption) AS recorded_values,
       MAX(ABS(y.Consumption - ROUND(y.Consumption, 2))) AS max_subcent,
       MAX(ABS(y.Consumption)) AS largest_magnitude
FROM main.customers AS c
JOIN main.yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND y.Date >= '201301' AND y.Date < '201401'
GROUP BY c.Segment

decimal_bounds AS (
  SELECT group_id, scaled_value,
    COUNT(scaled_value) OVER g AS n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN scaled_value IS NOT NULL AND typeof(scaled_value) <> 'integer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS invalid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(scaled_value) = 'integer' AND scaled_value NOT BETWEEN -90071992547409 AND 90071992547409 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS oversized_count,
    TOTAL(CASE WHEN typeof(scaled_value) = 'integer' AND scaled_value BETWEEN -90071992547409 AND 90071992547409 THEN ABS(scaled_value) ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS abs_total
  FROM decimal_input
  WINDOW g AS (PARTITION BY group_id)
), decimal_totals AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count,
    CASE WHEN invalid_count > 0 THEN 'invalid_input'
      WHEN n = 0 THEN 'empty'
      WHEN oversized_count > 0 OR abs_total > 90071992547409
        OR n > 90071992547409 THEN 'overflow'
      ELSE 'ok' END AS status,
    SUM(CASE WHEN invalid_count = 0 AND oversized_count = 0
      AND abs_total <= 90071992547409 AND n <= 90071992547409
      THEN scaled_value END) AS scaled_sum
  FROM decimal_bounds
  GROUP BY group_id
), decimal_fraction AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count, status,
    scaled_sum * 100 AS numerator, 100 AS denominator
  FROM decimal_totals
), decimal_rounded AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count, status,
    CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN numerator / denominator
      + CASE WHEN ABS(numerator % denominator) >= (denominator + 1) / 2
        THEN CASE WHEN numerator < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END ELSE 0 END END AS rounded_units
  FROM decimal_fraction
), decimal_result AS (
  SELECT *, rounded_units * 1.0 / 100 AS rounded_value
  FROM decimal_rounded
)

WITH decimal_input AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID AS group_id, CAST(ROUND(y.Consumption * 100) AS INTEGER) AS scaled_value
  FROM main.customers AS c
  JOIN main.yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND y.Date >= '201301' AND y.Date < '201401'
), decimal_bounds AS (
  SELECT group_id, scaled_value,
    COUNT(scaled_value) OVER g AS n,

    SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(scaled_value) = 'integer' AND scaled_value NOT BETWEEN -90071992547409 AND 90071992547409 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS oversized_count,
    TOTAL(CASE WHEN typeof(scaled_value) = 'integer' AND scaled_value BETWEEN -90071992547409 AND 90071992547409 THEN ABS(scaled_value) ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS abs_total
  FROM decimal_input

), decimal_totals AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count,

      AND abs_total <= 90071992547409 AND n <= 90071992547409
      THEN scaled_value END) AS scaled_sum
  FROM decimal_bounds
  GROUP BY group_id
), decimal_fraction AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count, status,
    scaled_sum * 100 AS numerator, 100 AS denominator
  FROM decimal_totals
), decimal_rounded AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count, status,
    CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN numerator / denominator
      + CASE WHEN ABS(numerator % denominator) >= (denominator + 1) / 2
        THEN CASE WHEN numerator < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END ELSE 0 END END AS rounded_units
  FROM decimal_fraction
), decimal_result AS (
  SELECT *, rounded_units * 1.0 / 100 AS rounded_value
  FROM decimal_rounded
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, d.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY c.Segment ORDER BY d.rounded_units, d.group_id

       MAX(CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN group_id END) AS customer_id,
       MIN(rounded_value) AS minimum_total
FROM ranked GROUP BY Segment, status

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID,
           SUM(CAST(ROUND(y.Consumption * 100) AS INTEGER)) AS total_cents
    FROM main.customers AS c
    JOIN main.yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date >= '201301' AND y.Date < '201401'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(y.Consumption) > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total_cents,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_cents, CustomerID
           ) AS position
    FROM customer_totals
),
winners AS (
    SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total_cents
    FROM ranked
    WHERE position = 1
)
SELECT sme.CustomerID AS sme_customer_id,
       lam.CustomerID AS lam_customer_id,
       kam.CustomerID AS kam_customer_id,
       ROUND((sme.total_cents - lam.total_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS sme_minus_lam,
       ROUND((lam.total_cents - kam.total_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS lam_minus_kam,
       ROUND((kam.total_cents - sme.total_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS kam_minus_sme
FROM winners AS sme
CROSS JOIN winners AS lam
CROSS JOIN winners AS kam
WHERE sme.Segment = 'SME' AND lam.Segment = 'LAM' AND kam.Segment = 'KAM'
LIMIT 1
